# Redblue benchmarks

Generated by `cargo run --bin rb-bench`. Wall time is printed and recorded, but never asserted: timing assertions are flakes wearing a gate's clothes. The answer column is verified by the harness before a row is written.

| Workload | Size | Answer | Wall time |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| fibonacci | 20 | 6765 | 1.123 ms |
| primes | 1000 | 168 | 75.685 ms |
| concat | 200 |  | 1.438 ms |
| lex | 200 | 200 | 1.009 ms |

## Hardware

- CPU: AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor (4 CPUs)
- Build: debug (`cargo run --bin rb-bench`), linux x86_64
